say:1:1322462001:1.text: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
say:1:1322462001:1.source_cn: 这位大人，镇民们都有点不知所措……
say:1:1322462001:1.male: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...
say:1:1322462001:1.female: The villagers don't know what to do. They're confused...

say:3:1322462002:1.text: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.
say:3:1322462002:1.source_cn: 大家都吓坏了，不敢动弹，都想着和您一起回去。
say:3:1322462002:1.male: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.
say:3:1322462002:1.female: Everyone's in shock. Too scared to move. They just want to go back with you.

say:4:1322462003:1.text: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...
say:4:1322462003:1.source_cn: 多亏了您啊，真不敢想刚才离变成魔物就差那么一点点……
say:4:1322462003:1.male: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...
say:4:1322462003:1.female: Thank you for saving us! We were so close to becoming Hypofiends...

say:5:1322462004:1.text: Alright, alright, no more talk of Hypofiends. Let's head back with the Magister first...
say:5:1322462004:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，不要再提魔物了，先跟大人回去吧……
